description: This file contains functions and constants for detecting, loading, and processing image references within prompts, including handling various image path formats, media URIs, and sanitization, specifically for a system that integrates with media storage and sandboxed environments.

classes.name: DetectedImageRef
classes.description: Interface representing a detected image reference in a prompt, including raw text, type (path or media-uri), and resolved path.

methods.name: detectImageReferences
methods.description: Scans a prompt string for various image reference patterns, including paths, URLs, message attachments, media URIs, and returns an array of detected references.

methods.name: loadImageFromRef
methods.description: Loads an image based on a detected reference, handling media URIs and local paths, with sandbox and size limit options, returning ImageContent or null.

methods.name: modelSupportsImages
methods.description: Checks if a given model supports image input based on its input capabilities.

methods.name: detectAndLoadPromptImages
methods.description: Detects image references in a prompt, loads them, sanitizes, and returns images along with reference info, supporting models with vision capability.
